name: web-inline-stepper-with-checked-active-and-pending-circles
title: Three-step stepper with a checked black circle, an active numbered circle and a pale pending circle, titles and descriptions inline
whatItIs: A white frame with three steps in a row, each a circle followed by a title and a grey description: Step One with a black check, Step Two with a black '2', Step Three with a pale grey '3', joined by short dashes, with a small caption 'Stepper with inline titles and descriptions'.
whatItMeans: Clear and lightweight; contrast alone shows done, current and pending.
techniques: Show done as a filled check.
Show current as a filled number.

vocabulary.definition: A control showing progress through steps.
A step marked with a check.
A step shown in pale grey.
A title and description beside its marker.
